policy: Current-date analyst scenarios only. These do not approve or replace historical models. All financial observations remain reported in issuer currency; sources must be available by the model date. No market price is a valuation input.

q12026.locator: Cash flows; equity Note13; FCF reconciliation

conventions.cash: CFO already includes cash interest and tax. Deduct financing lease principal once. No separate debt deduction, cash addition, dividend addition, or buyback premium in parent FCFE.
conventions.sbc: Recurring SBC is treated as a cash-equivalent compensation allowance; existing unvested awards are not additionally added to shares. Already-exercisable options have no remaining vesting cost and receive one full share per option as an explicit conservative claim bound, with no exercise proceeds. This is not treasury-stock-method diluted EPS.
conventions.capex: Reported cash PPE is distinct from management capex. The unexplained EUR9m TTM difference is an analyst reconciliation reserve, not mislabeled cash capex. Restricted-cash releases are excluded from recurring FCFE. Removing the reserve is a separate sensitivity.
conventions.earnings: No normalized-EPS or fair-value finance gains are used. No government/market claim is made for forecast growth or the discount rate.

SPOT.assumptionRationale: Explicit EUR nominal FCFE growth fades from 12% to 4% in the base case; 10% EUR equity hurdle and 2.5% terminal growth are analyst underwriting assumptions, not CAPM estimates or issuer guidance. Cash-equivalent compensation and leases remain in the growing cash-flow base. Five rolling forecast years start at the current valuation date; year-end discounting t=1..5, not historical fiscal-year relabeling.

conventions.cash: After recurring SBC and capitalized SBC, the diagnostic cash result is negative. Other financing outflows are conservatively reserved in full, not falsely described as an exact lease-only split. This cash diagnostic is not a DCF base.
conventions.model: EV/sales scenario only, never labeled DCF. No legal-award gain enters revenue. Operating cash and lease costs remain operating in the multiple convention; operating leases are shown but not deducted as financing debt again.
conventions.claims: All issued A+B shares plus all outstanding options, RSUs and disclosed ESPP potential shares form a conservative full-delivery claim bound. No option proceeds, vesting forfeiture benefit, or second legacy-SBC value deduction. A separate 2% next-year NEW-grant dilution assumption does not represent already counted awards.
conventions.cashBridge: Reserve all cash and equivalents for operations; add only separately identified marketable securities. Securities are issuer reported fair values, not income claims added twice.

IOT.assumptionRationale: 15%-30% forward revenue growth brackets a slowdown from the reported 30.5% latest quarter; 6x/10x/14x NTM sales are explicit analyst valuation scenarios inside the implemented software profile range, not claimed observed peer medians. The base is a scenario anchor, not an independently triangulated DCF or promised return.
